title: Write one pylock.toml entry for packages locked in both default and develop

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+Write a single ``pylock.toml`` entry for a package that ``Pipfile.lock`` lists in both ``default`` and ``develop``.
+Previously both copies were written, so installing with the dev group failed: ``uv pip install -r pylock.toml --group dev``
+reported multiple active entries, and Pipenv itself could not load the file (``has 2 entries that match the environment``).

@@ -143,10 +143,29 @@ def from_lockfile(
         dev_marker = " or ".join(f"'{g}' in dependency_groups" for g in dev_groups)
 
         # Process packages
+        default_packages = lockfile_data.get("default", {})
+        default_entries = {}
         for section in ["default", "develop"]:
             packages = lockfile_data.get(section, {})
             for name, package_data in packages.items():
+                # Pipfile.lock repeats a shared dependency in both sections.
+                # PEP 751 requires every install to narrow down to a single
+                # entry per package, so fold the develop copy into the
+                # default entry instead of writing a second one.
+                if section == "develop" and _same_locked_package(
+                    default_packages.get(name), package_data
+                ):
+                    _merge_develop_marker(
+                        default_entries[name],
+                        default_packages[name].get("markers"),
+                        package_data.get("markers"),
+                        dev_marker,
+                    )
+                    continue
+
                 package = {"name": name}
+                if section == "default":
+                    default_entries[name] = package
 
                 # Add version if present and not a wildcard
                 if "version" in package_data:
@@ -949,6 +968,31 @@ def convert_to_pipenv_lockfile(
         return lockfile
 
 
+def _same_locked_package(default_data, develop_data) -> bool:
+    """Whether two Pipfile.lock entries pin the same artifact, ignoring markers."""
+    if not isinstance(default_data, dict) or not isinstance(develop_data, dict):
+        return False
+
+    def without_markers(data):
+        return {key: value for key, value in data.items() if key != "markers"}
+
+    return without_markers(default_data) == without_markers(develop_data)
+
+
+def _merge_develop_marker(entry, default_markers, develop_markers, dev_marker):
+    """Widen a default entry's marker so it also covers the develop install."""
+    if not default_markers or develop_markers == default_markers:
+        # The default entry already applies whenever the develop one would.
+        return
+    if not develop_markers:
+        develop_condition = dev_marker
+    elif "dependency_groups" in develop_markers:
+        develop_condition = develop_markers
+    else:
+        develop_condition = f"({dev_marker}) and ({develop_markers})"
+    entry["marker"] = f"({default_markers}) or ({develop_condition})"
+
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "default_markers, develop_markers, expected_marker",
+    [
+        (None, None, None),
+        ("python_version >= '3.9'", "python_version >= '3.9'", "python_version >= '3.9'"),
+        (
+            "sys_platform == 'win32'",
+            None,
+            "(sys_platform == 'win32') or ('dev' in dependency_groups)",
+        ),
+        (
+            "sys_platform == 'win32'",
+            "python_version >= '3.9'",
+            (
+                "(sys_platform == 'win32') or "
+                "(('dev' in dependency_groups) and (python_version >= '3.9'))"
+            ),
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_from_lockfile_package_in_default_and_develop_has_one_entry(
+    tmp_path, default_markers, develop_markers, expected_marker
+):
+    """A package locked in both sections must narrow down to one entry (PEP 751).
+
+    Pipfile.lock repeats a shared dependency in "default" and "develop".  Two
+    pylock.toml entries for it both match when the dev group is selected.
+    """
+    import json
+
+    default_entry = {"version": "==26.3"}
+    develop_entry = {"version": "==26.3"}
+    if default_markers:
+        default_entry["markers"] = default_markers
+    if develop_markers:
+        develop_entry["markers"] = develop_markers
+    lockfile_content = {
+        "_meta": {"sources": [], "requires": {"python_version": "3.13"}},
+        "default": {"packaging": default_entry},
+        "develop": {"packaging": develop_entry, "pytest": {"version": "==9.0.0"}},
+    }
+    lockfile_path = tmp_path / "Pipfile.lock"
+    lockfile_path.write_text(json.dumps(lockfile_content))
+
+    pylock = PylockFile.from_lockfile(lockfile_path)
+
+    entries = [p for p in pylock.packages if p["name"] == "packaging"]
+    assert len(entries) == 1
+    assert entries[0].get("marker") == expected_marker
+    names = [p["name"] for p in pylock._narrow_package_entries()]
+    assert names.count("packaging") == 1
+
+
